# past-sessions

The launch dialog's Resume tab — a directory's Claude Code sessions listed from transcripts, the running-session guard, resume in the original mode.

Read first: `docs/features/past-sessions/spec.md`, `docs/features/past-sessions/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/launch-resume-pending-hold-persisted` — A session spawned with --resume X holds Claude session X until it binds or ends, and the hold is stored with its row so a daemon restart keeps it. (accepted, 2026-09-29; features: launch, past-sessions, actions) → `docs/adr/launch-resume-pending-hold-persisted.md`
- `kb:lesson/contract-claim-unchecked-against-carrier` — A contract promised a null the wire struct cannot carry, and keyed a guard on an id only a late hook assigns; both surfaced mid-run as user decisions.
